heading: Annotations
paper: Hippocampal replay and memory consolidation across sleep stages

annotations.passage: Replay events during NREM sleep predicted next-day recall better than awake rest (r = 0.61).
annotations.note: Does this hold when controlling for total sleep time? Fig. 3B suggests it might not.

annotations.passage: Optogenetic suppression of sharp-wave ripples abolished the consolidation benefit in all 14 animals.
annotations.note: Strongest causal evidence in the paper. Lead with this in the review.

annotations.passage: Sample size was 14 animals per group.
annotations.note: Small. Compare with Lindqvist's 2026 preprint replication (n = 40).

annotations.passage: Replay content was biased toward recently rewarded locations.
annotations.note: Is reward or novelty driving this? Ask Mehta.

annotations.passage: The effect persisted 7 days after training.
annotations.note: Long retention window — relevant to our grant aim 2.
